name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or capability for BPFQuest
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "feature"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please provide a clear description (e.g., "I find it difficult to test network filter bytecode with custom PCAP files...").

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how it aligns with BPFQuest's focus on low-level Linux systems and eBPF.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Technical Considerations
Any relevant notes on security isolation, kernel requirements, or architectural impacts.
